title: Leaf-image species classification audit: code
description: Code for the article "Within-protocol accuracy does not transfer: an intervention-based audit of leaf-image species classification in tropical tree seedlings": leaf segmentation, the input-condition interventions, frozen ResNet-18 features, the corner condition, the grouped split and the evaluation with its empirical null and group bootstrap, with a demonstration on twelve example images and the aggregate result files. Code under the MIT License; result files under CC BY 4.0.
